title: Flint Canyon Tennis Club

services.name: Adult Clinics
services.desc: Come on out and get active again! The club is open for both singles & doubles play. We are also currently hosting private, semi-private lessons, and easing into hosting some open clinics as well! Adult Clinics: Members may reserve their places up to 1 month in advance. Non-members may reserve just up to 1 week in advance. $35 - Members ($45 - Non-Members) Please Note: Some instructors have other “group classes”, not listed here, and are off of the semi-private pricing sheet. Please inquire about which of these semi-private groups you may be able to join in

explain.meaning: A group lesson focused on one skill.
